source: Spectrum 2 icon geometry: 20px canvas, 1.5px stroke, 2.25 outer corner radius, shown at the 16px compact size; currentColor fill. Icons marked s2 copy the path data of the named @react-spectrum/s2 icon (Apache-2.0); the window icons share the square frame (2–18) of the user-provided S2 expand-right panel icon; icons marked drawn are BaoCut's own on that frame.

sidebar.svg.shape: square frame + panel bar x 5, y 5–15, 4 wide (the expand-right bar widened)
sidebar.svg.role: sidebar toggle while the sidebar is shown; pin button in the sidebar peek

sidebar-hidden.svg.shape: square frame + panel bar x 5, y 5–15, 1.5 wide (the expand-right icon as provided)
sidebar-hidden.svg.role: sidebar toggle while the sidebar is hidden

tabs.svg.role: tabs button frame; holds the plus overlay or the open-tab count

tabs-plus.svg.shape: plus 6.75–13.25 on the 20px grid, 1.5px stroke, round caps
tabs-plus.svg.role: overlay inside the tabs button frame when no tab is open

full.svg.shape: two corner brackets from S2 FullScreen (1.5px stroke, 1.25 outer radius, sharp inner corner) at top-right and bottom-left, pointing out; the previous glyph's layout scaled to a 1.5px stroke: 4.5–15.5, arms 5.75, brackets overlapping by 0.5
full.svg.role: enter full view; open-tabs row trailing button

exit-full.svg.shape: the same two brackets turned to point in, as in S2 FullScreenExit; 3.5–16.5, arms 5.75, 1.5 gap between the brackets

hide-tabs.svg.role: tabs button while the split pane is visible (hide tabs)
